elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added clause applies “Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must, at Client’s request, provide reasonable transition and migration assistance “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The assistance is provided “at TrueLink’s then-current rates.”

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The 30-day deadline runs from Client’s request, not from expiration or termination, and no return is required absent a request.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must return all Client Content and other Client data in a “commonly used, machine-readable format.”

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: After the return obligation, TrueLink must delete the Client Content and Client data and certify deletion to Client in writing.

elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added clause applies “Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must provide requested transition assistance for up to six months, making at least a 90-day assistance period available to Client.

elements.element: Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The export deadline is 30 days after Client’s request rather than 30 days after expiration or termination, and export is not automatic.
